# libairspy

The Airspy host library, copied unmodified from
<https://github.com/airspy/airspyone_host> (`libairspy/src`) at commit
`fc61ab6be57ed61f0e2bdd9c6dfae74cacef57d0` (version 1.0.12).

It is compiled into the driver on Android only, where there is no system
libairspy to load. Its licence (BSD 3-clause; the I/Q converters are MIT) is
at the top of each file.
